## Project Name
Post Disaster Housing Finance

## One-Line Description
A Stellar testnet housing finance app for transparent post-disaster aid, milestone releases, and beneficiary records.

## Track
Track 5 Social Impact

## Problem It Solves
After typhoons, floods, and earthquakes, housing aid can move through slow and opaque manual processes. Families need faster support, while donors and local groups need proof that funds are tied to real rebuilding milestones. This app gives disaster recovery teams an auditable housing finance workflow.

## How It Uses Stellar
The app uses Stellar testnet accounts through Freighter, Stellar SDK RPC/Horizon clients, Soroban smart contracts for verifiable state, Stellar asset/SAC-ready payment configuration, and an x402-style payment quote route. It also includes a disclosed OpenZeppelin Relayer integration profile: The app includes an OpenZeppelin Relayer profile so disaster beneficiaries can be supported with gasless transaction submission when the relayer API key is configured.
